cognitive_evolution.new_pattern_detected: Shared micro-lib extraction (sanitize/url_filters/apply_status/config_resolver) is the evolved form of the minimal-footprint rule: instead of forbidding code, it forbids duplication — one importable helper, zero inline repeats, engine contracts untouched.
cognitive_evolution.changed_from_prior_belief: Previously verification meant re-reading code; now it means diffing the working tree first — a prior pass may have fixed half the claims, and re-fixing wastes motion and risks regressions.
cognitive_evolution.consistency_with_axioms: Axiom 1 (runtime reality over assumptions — every claim re-derived with file:line). Axiom 2 (generic parameter-driven systems — whitelist/honeypot/CDP/keywords all config-driven). Axiom 4 (investigator + precision implementer). Axiom 5 (two-repo isolation — separate writes, no cross-imports, no joint commits).

long_term_application.future_implication: 1) On any supplied audit: git diff first, verify each item, mark rejected claims explicitly. 2) On god-file growth: extract micro-libs under core/utils/* with AI CONTEXT headers, never split engine contracts. 3) On success claims: require DOM evidence constants from apply_status (never drawer-close alone). 4) On privacy tests: scope live-name assertions to Repo_A; Repo_B memory is allowed historic context. 5) On past-entry corrections: redact to placeholders + append evolved-thinking refs, never rewrite history.
long_term_application.cross_project_note: Verification-first + micro-lib extraction + append-only evolution is a universal owner trait — apply in any workspace when handed an external audit or a grown codebase.
